policy: Fresh temporary Electron profile with one persistent partition per resolution. Fixed test accounts; product UI is the only catalog/storage writer. DOM form clicks/input/change and GameCanvas keyboard edges. Read-only component, DOM and localStorage observation. No fixture data, state/permission/clock/ledger writes or app API bypass. BrowserWindow is closed/reopened with the same partition for persistence/account checks. Direct CDP screenshots, no image edits. Only worlds created by this harness may be tombstoned.

Actual minimal Cocos runtime spawns without T6/T7/deep trace/media or ledger events

Exit destroys minimal runtime before rendering folder again
Delete cancellation preserves data, confirmation hides only harness-created world
Close/reopen same persistent profile/partition preserves metadata and tombstone
Reenter restarts protagonist at spawn without persisting gameplay state
Second account starts independent catalog; original account remains unchanged
Viewport/canvas/raw PNG dimensions match requested resolution and no overflow

checks.name: UI creates distinct local world metadata and lists multiple worlds
Fork control reports not open and creates no catalog/storage change
Actual minimal Cocos runtime spawns without T6/T7/deep trace/media or ledger events
GameCanvas keyboard movement and jump use existing input/frame/director path
Exit destroys minimal runtime before rendering folder again
Delete cancellation preserves data, confirmation hides only harness-created world
Close/reopen same persistent profile/partition preserves metadata and tombstone
Reenter restarts protagonist at spawn without persisting gameplay state
Second account starts independent catalog; original account remains unchanged
Viewport/canvas/raw PNG dimensions match requested resolution and no overflow
